items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is identified in the metadata as the 'recording engineer' and speaks only to adjust the microphone ('When you’re ready', 'It should be able to pick her up'). There is no evidence of a personal or professional musical relationship between Dave Brubeck and Ken Kimery in the transcript.

ctx.x: Interviewees: Dave Brubeck (December 6, 1920 – December 5, 2012) with Russell Gloyd and Iola Brubeck (August 14, 1923 – March 12, Interviewers: Ted Gioia with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 90 pp.

Track markers were accidentally embedded into the original recording in such a way as to lose a few words at the breaks. Square brackets and five spaces – [ ] – indicate these small gaps in the transcription.
